relations: Small bubbles suspended in the yellow-green liquid drift slowly upward, driven by buoyancy within the fluid.
Larger spheres remain largely stationary, anchoring the central cluster while the tiny bubbles rise steadily.
The thin amber rims and internal specks persist on each bubble throughout the slow vertical drift.
caption: The video showcases a macro close-up of spherical bubbles suspended in a translucent liquid, the color field running from bright yellow at the left to deep olive green at the right. A large, partially cropped bubble occupies the left edge, its curved boundary catching a soft highlight, while a dense cluster of bubbles fills the center and right. Each bubble is outlined by a thin, refractive rim glowing amber against the darker background, with faint specks hanging within. Across the sequence the larger spheres remain largely in place, while the smaller bubbles drift slowly upward. The two tiny bubbles close together near the upper center rise steadily, and the single small bubble at the far right climbs toward the middle. The cluster stays intact, presenting a gently shifting view of the immiscible fluids.
